description: Update a weclapp contact person. Required: contact_id and fields (only the values to change — the record is read first and the changes are merged onto it, so untouched fields keep their values). Fails rather than overwrites if someone else changed the record in the meantime. WRITES into the customer's ERP — it goes through the permission gate and the weclapp write log.

contact_id.description: ID of the contact to change

fields.description: Field values to set (API field name → value)

name: update_weclapp_contact
